scope: Independent result audit of the corrected local KOBIS identity and cross-source proposal outputs. This validates reproducibility, preservation, counts, and proposal boundaries; it does not verify proposed cross-source identities or establish recommendation performance.
interpretation_limits: The 2,176 movie entities are KOBIS codes directly observed on official screens; the 70,400 code-free rows are observations, not a unique-film count.
The 2,682 KOBIS and 13,779 row-level TMDB similarities are proposals only and do not enter confirmed movie rollups.
PROPOSED_UNIQUE means one catalog candidate under the documented metadata rule, not a shared-ID or manual identity verification.
No TMDB, service, or MovieLens identity is confirmed by this output, and no MovieLens rating is attached to a proposal.
Last-observed cumulative values use only direct-code rows at their recorded period_end and are neither current values nor complete original-lifetime totals.
This result contains no model training, recommendation lift, Korean-user preference validation, or service-readiness evidence.
final_assessment: PASS. linked-v2 exactly preserves the independently audited 72,700-row corrected collection, restricts confirmed KOBIS movie rollups to 2,300 direct-code observations, keeps all metadata-based KOBIS and TMDB identities as auditable proposals, leaves every cross-source confirmed ID and attached rating value null, and matches its pinned manifest, CSV/Parquet pairs, summary, and report.
